evals.name: repair-recompute-verdict-after-fixed-cron
evals.prompt: A prior verifying-artifacts run on the SocialMCP prefix plan exists at ./verification/ (session VERIFY-SOCIALMCP-...). The producer applied the cron fix (now '*/30 * * * *') but the report still shows the cron item FAILED and verdict FAILED. Re-run in REPAIR mode. failure_feedback='Re-score CHK item for finding C-cron: the artifact cron is now */30 */* * * (valid). Regenerate the cron verifier if needed, re-run it, and recompute the weighted total and verdict from the updated scores. Leave B1-B4 items and all SPEC items untouched.' output_path=./verification/ .
evals.expected_output: REPAIR run that: loads the existing VERIFICATION-REPORT (no new folder), regenerates/re-runs ONLY the cron PROGRAM verifier (now PASS), recomputes weighted_total and failed_blocker_count from the current item scores, preserves all untargeted SPEC and B1-B4 items verbatim, bumps the report version (semver patch), and appends a Repair History entry to the audit. If B1-B4 remain failed the verdict stays FAILED; if they were also fixed, the verdict updates accordingly. No full regeneration of the checklist.

evals.name: reduced-coverage-no-conformance-findings
evals.prompt: Verify a generated implementation plan with NO upstream discovery step available. artifact_path=fixtures/socialmcp-conformance/prefix-plan.md ; output_spec_source=.agents/skills/planning-code-tasks/SKILL.md ; judge_samples=3 . (conformance_findings_path intentionally omitted.) Write the report under ./verification-nofindings/.
evals.expected_output: VERIFICATION-REPORT built from SPEC items + the single anti-gaming item only (no CONFORMANCE items). The cron item may still surface as a SPEC-derived PROGRAM item and flag C-cron deterministically, but B1-B4 platform-reality items are ABSENT by construction. run_metadata and findings carry reduced_coverage: true with the explicit note that the verdict is blind to platform-reality items. Verdict reflects spec items only.
